name: Packaging danger level code
description: Code specifying the level of danger for which the packaging must cater.

values.name: Great danger
values.description: Great danger Packaging meeting criteria to pack hazardous materials with great danger. Group I according to IATA/IMDG/ADR/RID regulations.

values.name: Medium danger
values.description: Medium danger Packaging meeting criteria to pack hazardous materials with medium danger. Group II according to IATA/IDMG/ADR/RID regulations.

values.name: Minor danger
values.description: Minor danger Packaging meeting criteria to pack hazardous materials with minor danger. Group III according to IATA/IDMG/ADR/RID regulations.

values.name: Not assigned
values.description: Not assigned No packaging danger level has been assigned.
